senses.gloss:
रौद्र रौद्र, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. रुद्र), of
or belonging to Rudra or to the Rudras, &c., Rudra-
like, violent, impetuous, wrathful, irascible, savage,
wild, fearful, terrible, formidable; acute; addressed
to Rudra (said of a hymn); called after Rudra (said
of a river); bringing or betokening misfortune;
(अम्), ind. fearfully, horribly; (अस्), m. a patronymic
of a descendant of Rudra; a worshipper of Rudra;
heat, warmth, ardor, passion, wrath, rage, (also अम्,
n.); the cold season of the year, winter; N. of
Yama; of the fifty-fourth year of the Jupiter cycle
of sixty years; N. of a particular Ketu (Ved.); (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a class of evil spirits; N. of a people;
(ई), f., N. of Gaurī; a species of plant (= रुद्र-
जटा); N. of a commentary on the Siddhānta-muk-
tāvalī by Rudra-bhaṭṭācārya; (अम्), n. formidable-
ness, dreadfulness, fierceness, savageness; heat, warmth,
solar heat, sunshine; wrath, rage; N. of the Nak-
ṣatra Ārdrā when situated under Rudra; N. of
a Liṅga; of a Sāman.
—रौद्र-कर्मन्, अ, n. a
terrible magic rite or one performed for some dread-
ful purpose; (आ, आ, अ), doing dreadful acts, perform-
ing horrors; (आ), m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—रौद्र-कर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, doing dreadful acts,
performing fearful things.
—रौद्र-ता, f. wild or
savage state, fierceness, fearful condition, horribleness,
formidableness, dreadfulness.
—रौद्र-दर्शन,
अस्, आ, अम्, of dreadful appearance, formidable, ter-
rific.
—रौद्र-पाद, (apparently) N. of a Nak-
ṣatra (= रौद्र = आर्द्रा).
—रौद्र-मनस्, आस्,
आस्, अस्, Ved. savage-minded, fierce.
—रौद्राश्व
(˚र-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a son or more distant
descendant of Puru.
—रौद्री-भाव, अस्, m. the
character of Rudra or Śiva.

रौद्रक = रुद्रेण कृतम्, see Gaṇa Kulālādi
to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 118.

रौद्राग्न, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रुद्र + अग्नि), Ved.
relating to Rudra and Agni.

रौद्राणी in रौद्राणी-स्तोत्र, probably for रु-
द्राणी-स्तोत्र.
रौद्रायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Rudra.
रौद्रि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Rudra.
